title: At the counter
text: This is our café. The counter is over here, next to the entrance. There is a shelf behind the counter, and the mugs are on it. My notebook and my charger are in front of the socket, near the window. Those seats over there are free. The receipt is on the counter, next to the small plant. Is this your mug? Yes, it is. Are those tables available? No, they are not. They are for the kitchen team.
